subject_label: Three Days of Happiness original novel

entity_aliases.note: Katakana form by which the lifespan-shop clerk addresses the narrator (クスノキさん) at U02 P0143, his first naming.

evidence.label: U01 accepted multi-agent deep reading: the unnamed narrator as a boy and at about twenty
evidence.provenance_note: Canonical v1.0 reading of the front matter and chapter 1, accepted with corrections after independent specialist passes and critical review. Section 7 analyzes the then-unnamed first-person narrator (self-valuation, ostracism, authenticity, Himeno's epistemic authority over him, hedging narration); section 8 gives directional relationships at U01 exit. U02 identifies this narrator as Kusunoki.

evidence.label: U02 accepted multi-agent deep reading: Kusunoki at twenty and the lifespan sale
evidence.provenance_note: Canonical v1.0 reading of chapter 2, accepted with corrections after independent specialist passes and critical review. Section 7 analyzes Kusunoki's poverty, self-valuation, wit, contempt, credulity and the questions he leaves unasked at the sale decision; section 6 analyzes his register shifts; section 8 gives directional relationships at U02 exit. Rival motives for the sale remain OPEN.

analytical_coverage.scope_note: Distributed analysis in the accepted readings of U01 (front matter and chapter 1) and U02 (chapter 2) of the single Japanese witness TDH-JP-01, run TDH-RUN-20261116-U01-U15. Each reading keeps its own knowledge boundary. No U03–U15, synthesis, monograph, other edition, translation or adaptation coverage is claimed.

notes: First-person narrator, unnamed in U01 and named Kusunoki at U02 P0143. Early-run enrollment from two of fifteen sequential units; the project's synthesis and reconstruction frontiers are empty. Inclusion is not monograph qualification or a reconstruction-capability grade.
